title: Tool Calls Registry File (tool_calls.json)
description: Schema for the tool calls registry. Per ADR-0011, NPCs emit allowlisted tool calls that the engine validates and executes. This file declares every tool call's signature: parameters, types, what state it mutates, what events it emits. The engine matches NPC allowlist entries against this registry.

description.description: Designer-facing description. Also included in the LLM prompt as documentation for what this tool does.

parameters.description: Parameters the LLM must supply when emitting this tool call. The engine validates each parameter type at runtime before executing.

state_mutations.description: Categories of state this tool call can mutate. Used for replay analysis, audit, and conflict detection in multiplayer. Empty array means side-effect-free.

emits_event_type.description: Optional event type emitted to the shared event log when this tool call executes. Storylets can match against the event type.

guard_against_injection.description: If true, the engine validates that the LLM's stated reason for this tool call matches actual game state. Mitigates the Where Winds Meet narrative injection class of exploits. Per ADR-0011.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Per-NPC rate limit. Prevents the LLM from spamming a tool call.

cooldown_seconds.description: Per-NPC cooldown between calls. Higher than rate_limit for narratively-significant calls.

enum_values.description: Required when type is 'enum'. The allowed string values.

urn_kinds.description: Required when type is 'reference_urn' or 'runtime_reference_urn'. Allowed URN kinds (e.g., ['item', 'block']).

range.description: Optional. Required for integer or number parameters with bounded values.
